column1: # Graph Settings overlay — slice B of docs/GRAPH_PLAN.md.
# Pressing `/G` from READY enters Mode::Menu and overlays the four-panel
# Graph Settings sheet on top of the worksheet area for the duration of
# the /Graph subtree. Esc dismisses the menu and the overlay disappears.
# Reference: Lotus 1-2-3 R3.1 Reference p. 2-230 ("Graph Settings"
# Baseline: not in /Graph yet, no overlay on screen.
# Esc pops one level: out of /Graph, back to root menu. The overlay
# disappears because we are no longer in the /Graph subtree.
# Second Esc dismisses the menu entirely.
